about: Demo data for unreachable-leaver recovery (Round 3, improvement 1). Read by src/lib/lacuna/recovery.ts for demo workspaces only. Sample answers are matched to an asked step by entity, check key and the person's display name.

I think it is 1 Dec, but I only heard that from Kabir.

leaverAnswers.text: Arjun Rao holds it now; I handed it over in person on 9 Nov. Ask him, never post it in a chat.
Open the Actions tab: the last green run is the build the latest release holds. Main has been red since 5 Nov, so the release is still the 3 Nov build.
The next-term lab booking form must reach Mr. Pawar by 1 Dec 2026. Kabir is right; 5 Dec was last year's date.
Log in to NameHarbor with the club account, lower the TTL a week before, press Renew for one year and pay with the club card. Ananya has the card.
The one step left before launch is wiring the confirmation email template in website/register.js and sending a test registration.
The next late-access evening is 19 Nov 2026. Message Mr. Pawar by Monday 16 Nov.
Message Mr. Pawar two days before, then sign the late register at the security gate. There is no form.
Arjun Rao decides drive team selection from now on, with Rohan signing off the final list.
Trials are on 22 Nov 2026. Tanvi's 29 Nov was the old plan before the venue moved.
Still open for Vertex: the logo on the robot shell, a banner at the competition and a sponsorship report with photos afterwards.
The entry fee is due on 25 Nov 2026. Dev's 28 Nov is the late date with the double fee.

withLeaverNote: Filled by the precompute step with measureLeaverRun(ws) on a scratch demo workspace: the real stored run in which the leaver answers every open question. While null, the panel uses the projection worked out by the scoring rules and says so.

expected.measuredOn: the planted claims of ground_truth.json with the deterministic stand-in (tests/db/recovery.test.ts). Responsibility keys are the ones the inventory assigns in a workspace, shown with their entity.

gaps.note: The tech lead cannot see the finance side of this conflict, so every rung reads 'Nothing here for your role.' for that role.

skips.why: A risk about the sponsorship is recorded only in the handover prep note, which the Treasurer cannot read. One hidden record on the topic is enough to wall a role off.
